g.text: Knowledge Base (left) · pillar layer · two entry agents · one Orchestrator · pillar specialists · Table-Agent data layer
A · PILLAR LAYER — one active pillar parameterizes the whole session
focus: delinquency · bureau · model scores · capacity
focus: limit utilisation · burst risk signals
active pillar's YAML parameterizes the Orchestrator (team_construction) and every specialist (focus + prompt_overlay)
B · ENTRY BOUNDARY — Q&A and Report requests
Q&A guardrail + chat · loads three skills:
C · ORCHESTRATOR — drives Q&A and Report modes
single fixed agent · routes both modes to a grounded answer / report
one Base Agent + domain skill + pillar YAML
Q&A mode → Orchestrator selects N domains (dynamic)
Report mode → invokes ALL pillar specialists in parallel, each runs report_generation
7 domains: bureau · crossbu · modeling · spend_payments · wcc · customer_rel · capacity_afford
ReportSpec + team results return to the Orchestrator — synthesis merges them
→ returns FinalAnswer to ChatAgent and Case Report to ReportAgent (top ↑)
D · DATA LAYER — Table Agents own & maintain the Shared Data Catalog
one Table Agent per specialist domain — owns its table(s), keeps them healthy, publishes a catalog entry (data_maintenance · data_catalog_sync)
union of per-table entries (11 tables) · read by Orchestrator (team_construction) & specialists (data_query)
loaded by skills.loader · injected at LLM calls
Evidence → Risk Implication); section_planning = report-mode plan
domain skill (one per pillar/specialist) injected via skills.domain.loader
pillar YAML swaps the lens — same Base Agent, zero code change
keep tables healthy · own a high-quality catalog entry per table
agents — same symbol · colour = role (blue orchestration · green data · purple memory)
dedups & links atomic facts across cases · retrieves on demand
